meta.title: OpenAI Usage
meta.description: View official OpenAI account usage, costs, and monthly spend limit.

ui.title: Usage and costs
ui.subtitle: View your official OpenAI account data in Harness
ui.keyHelp: Account usage and costs require a separate Admin API Key. A regular model API key cannot be used here.
ui.setupOrganization: Open the admin keys page and select the organization you want to view.
ui.setupCreate: Create a dedicated admin key for this plugin. If the option is unavailable, contact your organization administrator.
ui.setupSave: Paste and save the key below. Harness manages it locally through its credential service; it is never added to chat content.
ui.storageReadOnly: Credential storage is read-only. Configure {ref} through Harness credentials.
ui.replaceNote: The key is saved under this plugin's credential reference. Replacing it overwrites the key previously saved for this plugin.
ui.setupRequired: Configure an admin key to view usage.
ui.notEnforcing: This limit is not currently enforced
ui.limitHelp: Availability depends on account permissions and API support
ui.balanceHelp: No verified public balance API is available. A spend limit is not an account balance.
ui.noDailyCosts: No cost records for the selected period.
ui.modelHelp: This table uses the official model usage API. Account costs may also include storage, images, tools, and other charges.
ui.noUsage: No model usage records for the selected period.
ui.costNote: Costs are aggregated from OpenAI records and may be delayed or adjusted. They are not final invoices, credit purchases, or payments. Dates use UTC; the update time uses your local time zone.
ui.error.FORBIDDEN: Only the Harness owner can view or configure account information.
ui.error.INVALID_KEY: Enter an Admin API Key starting with sk-admin-. A regular model key cannot query organization billing.
ui.error.READ_ONLY: Credential storage is read-only. Set the admin key through Harness credentials.
ui.error.CREDENTIAL_STORAGE: Could not save the admin key. Check the write permissions for Harness credential storage.
ui.error.INVALID_RANGE: Choose this month, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.
ui.error.INVALID_RESPONSE: OpenAI returned incomplete data. This section is excluded from the totals. Retry or check the official usage page.
ui.error.TIMEOUT: The query timed out. Please try again later.
ui.error.NETWORK: Cannot connect to OpenAI. Check your network or proxy settings and retry.
ui.error.AUTH: The admin key is invalid, expired, or revoked. Configure a new Admin API Key.
ui.error.PERMISSION: This key cannot access this data. Check the Admin API Key and organization permissions.
ui.error.UNAVAILABLE: This account or API does not provide this information.
ui.error.RATE_LIMIT: OpenAI has rate-limited these queries. Refresh again later.
ui.error.QUERY_REJECTED: OpenAI rejected the query. Check the project ID or retry without filters.
ui.error.UPSTREAM: OpenAI cannot provide this data right now. Please retry later.
ui.error.PAGINATION: Not all pages could be retrieved, so an incomplete total is not shown. Retry or select a shorter period.
ui.error.INVALID_PROJECT: Project IDs must start with proj_. Leave the field blank to query the entire organization.
ui.error.CONNECTION: Cannot connect to the Harness query service. Check that the plugin is enabled and retry.
ui.error.SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the key. Check the Harness connection and retry.
ui.error.UNKNOWN: The operation failed. Please retry or check the official usage page.
